boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on University Hill’s campus-adjacent commercial corridors, each with one specific stop-in reason.

cards.title: See the illustrated interior at The Sink
cards.subtitle: 13th Street corridor — 1165 13th St.
cards.notes: Walk to 13th and Pennsylvania, then look over the illustrated walls and ceiling before choosing from the restaurant menu.
cards.short_summary: A long-running University Hill restaurant with a highly visual interior.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sink’s official site places it at 1165 13th St. on The Hill and describes its iconic art and ceiling signatures.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; consult the business for current seating and menu details.

cards.entity_name: Half Fast Subs on the Hill
cards.title: Pick a sandwich at Half Fast Subs
cards.subtitle: 13th Street corridor — 1215 13th St.
cards.notes: Use the 13th Street location page to confirm the stop, then order a sandwich for takeout or an on-site meal.
cards.short_summary: A University Hill sandwich shop with its Boulder address listed by the business.
cards.evidence_claim: Half Fast Subs lists its University Hill Boulder location at 1215 13th St.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Build a bowl at Rush Bowls
cards.subtitle: 13th Street corridor — 1207 13th St.
cards.notes: Head to the 1207 block of 13th Street and use the café as a quick meal or snack stop between campus activities.
cards.short_summary: A bowl-focused food stop on the central Hill corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hill Boulder dining directory lists Rush Bowls at 1207 13th Street.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; check the business directly for current hours.

cards.title: Make The Corner a breakfast stop
cards.subtitle: 13th Street corridor — 1100 13th St.
cards.notes: Walk south on 13th Street to the listed address and plan a seated meal rather than treating the block as a pass-through.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant on the southern stretch of University Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hill Boulder dining directory lists The Corner at 1100 13th Street.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; verify current hours and service details with the business.

cards.title: Order tea on Broadway
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor — 1121 Broadway St.
cards.notes: Cross to the Broadway side of the Hill and choose a tea drink from this named storefront’s current menu.
cards.short_summary: A tea-shop stop on the Broadway edge of University Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hill Boulder dining directory lists Kung-Fu Tea at 1121 Broadway Street.
cards.access_notes: Beverage purchase required; check the business for current hours.

cards.title: Pause for coffee at Alpine Modern Café
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 904 College Ave.
cards.notes: Use College Avenue as the route from campus, then stop at the café for a drink or food item from its current offerings.
cards.short_summary: A café destination along the College Avenue side of the Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hill Boulder dining directory lists Alpine Modern Café at 904 College Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Food or beverage purchase required; confirm current service information directly.

cards.title: Take a coffee break at Aviano
cards.subtitle: Pleasant Street corridor — 1253 Pleasant St.
cards.notes: Turn off 13th onto Pleasant Street and make the café a deliberate coffee or tea stop while exploring the Hill blocks.
cards.short_summary: A coffee shop on Pleasant Street beside the central Hill corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hill Boulder dining directory lists Aviano Coffee at 1253 Pleasant Street.
cards.access_notes: Beverage or food purchase required; verify current hours before going.

cards.title: Choose sushi at Bento-Ria
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — 1310 College Ave.
cards.notes: Follow College Avenue to the 1310 address and use this named restaurant for a sit-down or takeout food stop.
cards.short_summary: A sushi restaurant on the northern College Avenue Hill blocks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hill Boulder dining directory lists Bento-Ria Sushi at 1310 College Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; consult the business for current menu and hours.

cards.title: Pick up cookies on 13th Street
cards.subtitle: 13th Street corridor — 1203 13th St.
cards.notes: Find the 1203 block of 13th Street and make this listed bakery storefront a dessert or takeout stop.
cards.short_summary: A cookie-shop destination in the same central Hill block as other food stops.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hill Boulder dining directory lists Insomnia Cookies at 1203 13th Street.
cards.access_notes: Food purchase required; confirm current hours with the business.

cards.title: Look for art at Nick Ryan Gallery
cards.subtitle: Pennsylvania Avenue corridor — 1221 Pennsylvania Ave.
cards.notes: Leave 13th Street for Pennsylvania Avenue and visit the named gallery storefront as a visual-art stop on the Hill.
cards.short_summary: A retail-gallery destination one block off the main 13th Street spine.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hill Boulder retail directory lists Nick Ryan Gallery at 1221 Pennsylvania Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Gallery access and any purchases depend on current business operations; verify before visiting.
